utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, quick one. Tuesday 29th, let's get through stand-up. Everyone alright?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, not bad. Bit grim out though, isn't it? Proper autumn now. Weekend's meant to be a washout as well, if the forecast's right.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You say that every week, Tom, then you're out doing barbecue in a hoodie.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah well, optimistic engineering judgement, that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Speaking of important matters, there's still birthday cake in the office fridge from yesterday, if nobody's nicked it yet.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, that's breakfast sorted then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, priorities in order. Safety first, cake second. Callum, production?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Line-wise, mostly okay. I did see the pressure on the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so just keeping an eye on it. Not asking for anything off the back of it yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, noted, just an observation for now.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Apart from that we're running, but line one's still being a pain with the guarding situation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, on that one, Jamie, can you check the guarding on the line one on Friday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, Jamie can do that. I'll check the guarding on the line one on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. If we can get that squared away it'll stop the operators moaning at me, so appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. And Callum, can you send the shift handover report round?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, no problem, I'll send the shift handover report round.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one. Fi, planning side?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, couple of bits. I finished the repair on the chiller on three last night, so that's done, no action needed there today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good stuff.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: But I still can't get to the number two bearing until production gives us a window, so that's blocked at the minute.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, not today I don't think. Maybe later in the week if we get some breathing space.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's fine. Separate one, I'll do the pre-use checks on the trucks by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fi.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Were those the ones parked by dispatch? One of them looked like it'd had a rough night.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Probably has, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Jamie, stores?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah. I've already swapped the filter on the line 1 yesterday, so that's done and out the way.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the Line 3 Chiller, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood, that's just waiting then.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And, um, whenever you get a chance, I'll chase the purchase order for the turbine one compressor by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, good, thanks Jamie.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Worth chasing, that one's been floating about a bit too long.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, maintenance?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. I tested the line 2 interlock yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's closed off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nothing massive from me otherwise. Just normal checks. And, er, if the rain holds off I might actually get the garden sorted for once.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: It won't.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, I know, mate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Morning. Process side's fairly steady. I've got the water system paperwork still open from yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Aisha, can you update the risk assessment for work on the water system today?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll update the risk assessment for work on the water system today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. And can you also take vibration readings on the GT1? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, okay. I'll take vibration readings on the GT1. If I don't get to it first thing that's why, but low priority is fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's fine.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: On the water system one, just send me the latest version after, Aisha, and I'll have a look. Not a task for stand-up, just so I've seen it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, will do.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, anything HSE-wise?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Nothing major. Just keep the access clear by line one while you're sorting that guarding, because it was getting a bit cluttered yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, fair. Half of that wasn't even ours, mind.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: It never is, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else we need to raise, but only if it's actually for today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, main thing from me was the blocked bearing job, and that's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same here, nothing new. The interlock's done, so that's one less headache.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And just to be clear, Line 3 Chiller stays parked till parts land. No point pretending otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: For line one, once Jamie's checked the guarding on Friday, we'll know if we can get it fully back to normal.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Callum, the handover report round this morning please, because yesterday's got a few gaps.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, understood, I'll send the shift handover report round after this.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Who's on cake disposal then? Critical path item.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, no, that's holding morale up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Alright, enough. Quick recap then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie to check the guarding on the line one on Friday, that's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum to send the shift handover report round.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie will chase the purchase order for the turbine one compressor by end of day, whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha Begum to take vibration readings on the GT1, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha to update the risk assessment for work on the water system today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fi to do the pre-use checks on the trucks by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, got it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sound.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one, thanks all.
